provider: mastodonapp.uk / mstdn.social / mastodon.social and the stock-Mastodon mass — 100 MiB per object, unlimited per account

free_tier.stated: Per-account UNLIMITED. Per-file: 103809024 bytes = 99 MiB (video), 16 MiB image on almost every stock instance. mastodonapp.uk raises the IMAGE cap to 99 MiB too, which is the unusual bit.

egress.terms: Free. Media is offloaded to plain S3-compatible buckets behind the instance domain — verified on two live instances: mastodon.world serves from `s3.eu-central-2.wasabisys.com/mastodonworld/...` (Wasabi), mstdn.jp serves from `img.mstdn.jp/media_attachments/files/...`.

tooling: Mastodon REST API v1; `toot` CLI; Mastodon.py; Mastodon-API clients in every language.
chaining: THE quantity finding. Stock Mastodon has no per-account media quota — only a per-file validator. So a Mastodon account is a per-object-capped, per-account-unlimited store whose only real ceiling is (a) 30 uploads/30 min and (b) the operator's disk. There are thousands of open-registration instances. 1,000 instances x 99 MiB/object x 1,440 uploads/day is not the right sum; the right sum is 'each account is bounded by rate, not bytes', which makes the fediverse a permanent, free, CDN-fronted write target of effectively instance-disk size.
limits_note: mastodonapp.uk: image_size_limit and video_size_limit both 103809024 bytes (99 MiB), 4 media attachments per status; per-account unlimited and the API call rates are unverified on this host

identity_cost.detail: mastodonapp.uk sign-up steps: accept rules, your details, confirm email, review by the moderators; no phone or card step is listed

reliability_note: Registration state varies per instance and flips often — mastodon.social, mstdn.social, mstdn.jp, mastodon.world, mastodon.gamedev.place all reported registrations=true at probe time; mas.to, fosstodon.org, chaos.social, toot.community, mastodon.online reported false. Re-probe before relying on any one.
